row.team_price_text: Plans start at $20,000/year (custom quote; Core includes 5 users)
row.evidence: Reachdesk's pricing page says "Plans start at $20,000/year. Request a custom quote", and its help centre documents SCIM 2.0 provisioning at https://app.reachdesk.com/scim_v2 with an API token, set up through Okta's generic SCIM app.
row.notes: Quote-only: Reachdesk publishes no prices beyond 'Plans start at $20,000/year'; Core, Plus and Premium packages (5, 10, 15 users) are sold by custom quote and the pricing page does not say which package includes SSO or SCIM. SCIM 2.0 (bearer API token from Organization > Settings > API Tokens) is documented only for Okta via Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App; it creates users (default Sender role), updates names/emails, deactivates users and pushes Okta groups as Reachdesk teams. The Reachdesk OIN app itself is SAML only; Entra and OneLogin are documented for SAML SSO only. The JIT help article contradicts the SCIM guide by saying SCIM deprovisioning is not supported (see conflicts). The public REST API (sends, contacts, organization, transactions) has no user-management endpoints.

operations.notes: Updates documented (name, email) but not whether Reachdesk accepts PUT or PATCH. Unlinking a pushed group can delete the Reachdesk team.

deprovision.data_retained: Inactivation keeps the account record; unspent funds in the user's wallet return to the organization wallet.

attributes.notes: Docs only say names and emails sync and that some Okta user/team fields don't exist in Reachdesk; no attribute list is published. Group attributes inferred from Okta group push creating/renaming teams with members.

roles.how: SCIM-created users get the Sender role; change it in Reachdesk afterwards.

limitations.text: Only an Okta setup guide is published, using Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 test app; no Entra, OneLogin, Google or JumpCloud provisioning guide.
New SCIM users always start as Sender; role is not mapped from the IdP.
Some Okta user and team fields have no Reachdesk equivalent and are not synced.

scim.notes: Only documented for Okta, via Okta's generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token)' rather than the Reachdesk OIN app (which is SAML only). The Okta guide also sets up SAML in the same app, but does not say SSO must be enabled before SCIM.

user_api.notes: The public REST API (sends, bulk send, contacts, organization, transactions, GDPR requests) has no user, team or role endpoints; 'false' is by absence in the API reference index.

okta.notes: OIN app ticks SAML only (read from page markup). Provisioning is set up separately with Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App against the Reachdesk SCIM endpoint.

entra.notes: Vendor guide configures SSO with a non-gallery enterprise app; no provisioning guide.

onelogin.notes: From Reachdesk's own OneLogin guide (SAML); provisioning not mentioned.

fallbacks.notes: JIT creates users with the Sender role and assigns a team when the IdP group name matches; no updates or deprovisioning via JIT. Bulk user adds go through support or the CSM.
